visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean 10×10 percent grid beside two cards (fraction and decimal) and a fill slider. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Grid squares: warm paper white (roughness ~0.5); lit squares: warm amber (roughness ~0.45). Cards: warm paper plates with ink text (fraction card shows n/100, decimal card shows 0.n). Fill slider: soft warm-grey rail with amber knob. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: percent as a 10×10 grid where each square is one percent, with live fraction and decimal cards.

GEOMETRY: Percent grid: 100 small squares in 10 rows × 10 columns (spacing ~0.1) at x ≈ −0.9, y ≈ 0.25. Fill slider at the front lights 0..100 squares; the percent label updates. Two floating cards at x ≈ 0.7 show the same amount as a fraction (25/100) and decimal (0.25). A single-square tap highlights that one square = 1%.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) grid + lit squares; (2) fraction card; (3) decimal card.

CAMERA: head-on, slightly above, from +z frames grid and cards; labels legible. Budget 7-12k triangles. Named nodes: GridSquares, LitSquares, FillSlider_Knob, FractionCard, DecimalCard, PercentLabel. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
